text:
incidentbot: PagerDuty page fired: EMBED_QUEUE_HIGH (PD-43911). Impact: embeddings high latency/504s in eu-west for a small subset of tenants. Auto-escalate in 5m if unacked.
alice: Acked — I'm on it, joining the bridge.
bob: Oncall here, pulling metrics and kvcache histograms.
carla: Noted. Any immediate customer-visible errors?
alice: Yes — two tenants showing 504s and timeouts on /v1/embeddings. Trend spike at 13:02 UTC.
bob: Grafana: KV cache eviction rate spiked, memory pressure on embedder nodes. Autoscaler didn't add capacity.
dan: Picking up autoscaler logs now, looks like cloud API throttling on resize calls.
emily: If autoscaler blocked, short-term mitigation: reroute affected tenants to fallback pool. @alice can you run the admin reroute?
alice: Running `/admin/tenants/reroute --tenants alpha,gamma --pool fallback` now. Will post result.
pagerbot: Action: reroute job submitted (job id reroute-882). ETA ~30s.
bob: Seeing latency drop for alpha/gamma p50 -> 120ms. p90 for others still elevated (~800ms).
carla: Good. Open infra PD if autoscaler still failing after 2m.
dan: Opening INF ticket INF-789 with autoscaler logs and RateLimitExceeded traces. Pinging @infra-oncall.
alice: Drafting customer note: "We're investigating intermittent embedding failures for a small set of customers. We've applied a temporary reroute for affected tenants while we investigate autoscaler behavior. We'll follow up with an RCA." Thoughts?
emily: LGTM. Add ETA for next update in 30m.
carla: Send to affected customer list. CS notified.
pagerbot: PagerDuty: alert acknowledged by alice. Escalation timer paused.
bob: Will monitor metrics for 15m and keep this thread updated.
dan: Autoscaler shows RateLimit backoff from cloud provider; engineering to investigate retry/backoff logic.
alice: Confirming reroute success: no further 504s for alpha/gamma in last 2m.
emily: I'll queue a temporary throttling reduction on non-critical background jobs to reduce pressure.
carla: Thanks. Assigning post-incident owner for RCA: bob + dan.
alice: Customer notifications sent. Marking interim mitigation as applied.
pagerbot: PagerDuty: alert resolved (manual). If new alerts appear, page will re-fire.
bob: I'll keep an eye for 30m then sign off.
alice: Thanks everyone — handing back to normal ops. :white_check_mark: :pray:
incidentbot: Thread closed automatically after 10m inactivity.
